column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3530): the test runs once per dialect over forEachChainDialect, so in this PostgreSQL-only job the mysql and mssql arms skip while postgres RUNS. Each arm injects the failing insert through that dialect's own store, so the arms cannot be merged. Same shape as the retention tests it sits beside (see a-tenants-audit-chain-is-tamper-evident.tsv). Measured by NAME on a real PG-only report of ./plugins/auditlog/ (CLEAT_TEST_DB only): exactly these two.
